about.title: About Fountain Group
about.intro: We are a food products company focused on oils that belong in daily cooking—coconut oil under the Fountain Group name and Mama’s Red Oil for rich, familiar flavour.
about.founderMessageP1: At Fountain Group, our purpose is clear: to meet the growing need for carefully produced organic products. What we eat matters — and that is why we are here: to help more people gain access to organic oils and other organic products for everyday life.
about.founderMessageP2: We believe that healthy eating is healthy living. That belief guides how we work, what we produce, and the standard we hold ourselves to as we serve homes, retailers, and partners who share the same commitment to quality and wellbeing.
about.storyBody: Fountain Group grew from a simple idea: offer natural oils with honest labeling and packaging that works equally well on a kitchen counter and in a retail display. We invest in clear product information, dependable communication, and relationships with buyers who reorder because their customers trust what they stock.
about.produceBody: Our current lineup highlights Fountain Group Coconut Oil in glass retail bottles and Mama’s Red Oil in formats suited to households and larger-volume use. As we expand, new sizes and SKUs will be added here when they are confirmed.
about.approachBody: We combine careful production standards with practical commercial support—retail checkout for smaller orders, structured wholesale requests for bulk, and direct channels such as WhatsApp when a quick conversation helps.
about.visionBody: To be a trusted source of natural cooking oils for communities and businesses that value transparency, consistent quality, and partnerships built on clear expectations.

quality.title: Quality & care
quality.intro: Quality at Fountain Group means thoughtful sourcing, controlled handling, and packaging that protects the product from our facility to your shelf or kitchen.
quality.philosophyBody: We treat every bottle and container as something a family or customer will open with confidence. That means paying attention to cleanliness, traceability within our process, and instructions that are easy to follow.
quality.materialsBody: Our coconut oil and red oil products are positioned as natural food oils for cooking. Specific ingredient statements and origin details appear on product labels and pages as they are finalized for each market.
quality.productionBody: Processing steps are carried out with equipment and routines designed to maintain product integrity. We review procedures regularly and update this site when production practices change.
quality.packagingBody: Retail coconut oil is offered in glass bottles suited to visibility and shelf appeal. Mama’s Red Oil uses containers aligned with the sizes shown in our photography, including options for higher-volume use.
quality.storageBody: Store products in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight unless label directions specify otherwise. We publish storage notes on each product page for your team and end customers.
quality.handlingBody: Wholesale partners receive guidance on palletization, rotation, and shelf life so product arrives in the condition your buyers expect.
quality.assuranceBody: We monitor batches, document issues, and work with partners to resolve concerns quickly. If something is not right, contact us with your order or batch details so we can investigate.
quality.certsEmpty: Formal certification documents and third-party audit summaries will be published here when they are available for public sharing. Until then, ask our team for the documentation relevant to your market.
